meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 完成首次设置,跑通核心流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚拿到 omo,不知道第一步该做什么。
copy.tagline_en: Finish first-time setup and run through the core workflow.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just got omo and don't know the first step.

howto.what: 首次使用 omo 时,Claude 会当向导带你走六条线:功能导览、迁移帮助、会话考古、价值映射、记忆记录,以及首次会话的 init-deep 提议。它会按你首条回复的语言作答,并随时把关于你的长期事实写进 memory。
howto.when: 当新用户提出想开始用 omo 时触发。它只在首次自动启动一次,之后可用 `senpi --onboard` 手动唤回。

say.text: 我是第一次用 omo,带我过一遍
帮我把 Claude Code 的配置迁移过来
say.note: 先给出迁移方案,等你确认后才动手

say.text: 看看我以前编码助手的历史会话
say.note: 进入会话考古,会先征求你同意

howto.what_en: On first use of omo, Claude guides you through six lanes: tour, migration, session history, value mapping, memory, and a first-session init-deep proposal. It replies in your first message's language and saves durable facts to memory.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a new user asks to get started with omo. It auto-starts only once; later it can be brought back with the `senpi --onboard` flag.

say_en.text: I'm new to omo - walk me through it
Migrate my Claude Code config over
say_en.note: Shows a plan and waits for your yes.

say_en.text: Look through my previous agent sessions
